rules.item: Build from a clean machine or reproducible CI-like image.
rules.evidence: A real non-dry-run portable workspace build with dependency readiness and packaged clean-machine checks.

rules.item: Build the Electron app with the chosen backend runtime.
rules.evidence: electron-builder completed from the clean portable workspace and produced a packaged root.

rules.item: Validate packaged app with CDP/browser or Electron automation where possible.
rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke completed successfully.

rules.item: Test portable package or installer on Windows without the repo venv activated.
rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke and packaged clean-machine checks completed against the workspace build output.

rules.item: Validate shell startup, backend lifecycle, fallback URL, maintenance/log views, and user-data folder behavior.
rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke observed shell readiness, backend restart recovery, download redirection, storage, and runtime user-data root.

rules.item: Validate window sizing, file picker/download behavior, clipboard/image paste, drag/drop, websocket reconnect, and local storage/session behavior.
rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke observed Chromium window constraints, file input surface, download redirection, image paste/drop handlers, UI WebSocket reconnect, and storage persistence.

rules.item: Run packaged-app smoke tests for random prompt, Generate, result display, Prompt Tools, Params, Presets, Danbooru, Artist Thumb, img2img, Vibe Transfer Storage, Character Reference, Enhance, setup/API settings, history, save/output.
rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP feature smoke observed every required user-visible surface through non-destructive DOM, route, and websocket command evidence.

rules.item: Measure cold start, package size, dependency drift, data-file handling, update/patch behavior, and scanner result.
rules.evidence: Real portable workspace build recorded Electron CDP startup timing, packaged artifact measurement, dependency readiness, clean-machine data handling, distribution/update-state policy, and a required successful Defender scan.

rules.item: Measure cold start, first paint, random prompt latency after warmup, and Generate dispatch latency.
rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke recorded shell startup timing, first-paint proxy timing, actual random-prompt round-trip latency, and Generate dispatch latency.

when_done_rules.round: Round 0 - Baseline Freeze and Ownership Map
when_done_rules.item: Every candidate move has an owner, risk note, and validation command.
when_done_rules.evidence: Round 0 inventory and move-matrix documents are present.

when_done_rules.round: Round 0 - Baseline Freeze and Ownership Map
when_done_rules.item: The plan distinguishes upstream source weight from local runtime/downloaded asset weight.
when_done_rules.evidence: Runtime asset classification and write policy distinguish bootstrap source assets from runtime-downloaded/generated assets.

when_done_rules.round: Round 1 - Supported Remote Web Feature Contract Freeze
when_done_rules.item: Remote Web has a feature contract that can be regression-tested independently of PyQt.
when_done_rules.evidence: Remote Web feature contract validates all documented routes against the headless app source.

when_done_rules.round: Round 1 - Supported Remote Web Feature Contract Freeze
when_done_rules.item: Desktop-only code is not removed until its user-visible behavior is either migrated or explicitly declared unsupported.
when_done_rules.evidence: Legacy PyQt surfaces and legacy core boundaries are explicitly classified and release-excluded.

when_done_rules.round: Round 1 - Supported Remote Web Feature Contract Freeze
when_done_rules.item: Known broken features have route-level and UI-level owners.
when_done_rules.evidence: Remote Web feature contract lists feature groups, routes, source files, smoke levels, and live-smoke owners.

when_done_rules.round: Round 2 - Legacy/PyQt Isolation
when_done_rules.item: Tracked non-legacy runtime code has zero direct `PyQt6` imports.
when_done_rules.evidence: Supported import-boundary scan blocks PyQt6, legacy_desktop, and NAIA_cold_v4 imports outside classified legacy core files.

when_done_rules.round: Round 2 - Legacy/PyQt Isolation
when_done_rules.item: `requirements-headless.txt` remains PyQt-free.
when_done_rules.evidence: Headless requirements scan rejects GUI toolkit dependencies.

when_done_rules.round: Round 2 - Legacy/PyQt Isolation
when_done_rules.item: `NAIA_web_headless.py`, `core.web_session_app`, and core headless services import without `PyQt6`, `legacy_desktop`, or `NAIA_cold_v4`.
when_done_rules.evidence: Supported import-boundary scan covers the headless entrypoint and supported runtime packages.

when_done_rules.round: Round 2 - Legacy/PyQt Isolation
when_done_rules.item: Legacy desktop code remains reachable only through explicit legacy paths.
when_done_rules.evidence: Legacy PyQt surfaces and legacy core files are explicitly classified and release-excluded.

when_done_rules.round: Round 3 - Runtime Path Resolver and Asset Policy
when_done_rules.item: Downloaded data and UI assets have deterministic runtime destinations.
when_done_rules.evidence: Runtime write policy and asset classification define runtime destinations for downloaded/generated assets.

when_done_rules.round: Round 3 - Runtime Path Resolver and Asset Policy
when_done_rules.item: Bundled data is read-only/bootstrap-only.
when_done_rules.evidence: Runtime asset classification and release manifest separate source bootstrap assets from runtime assets.

when_done_rules.round: Round 3 - Runtime Path Resolver and Asset Policy
when_done_rules.item: No packaged read-only data file is used as mutable state.
when_done_rules.evidence: Runtime write policy blocks future writes/downloads into source data, source UI, and repository root targets.

when_done_rules.round: Round 3 - Runtime Path Resolver and Asset Policy
when_done_rules.item: The app can run from a copied temp/dist directory without assuming the source checkout root.
when_done_rules.evidence: Clean staged workspace evidence proves the backend can be staged into a separate workspace without source-root writes.

when_done_rules.round: Round 4 - Filesystem Layout Scaffolding
when_done_rules.item: New ownership directories exist without changing runtime behavior.
when_done_rules.evidence: Source layout contract validates the target backend, web, Electron, legacy, data, release, and test ownership directories.

when_done_rules.round: Round 4 - Filesystem Layout Scaffolding
when_done_rules.item: Existing headless entrypoint and Remote Web UI still run.
when_done_rules.evidence: Remote Web feature contract and supported import-boundary scan validate the headless source after scaffolding.

when_done_rules.round: Round 4 - Filesystem Layout Scaffolding
when_done_rules.item: Future moves have target paths and import compatibility strategy.
when_done_rules.evidence: Source layout contract and backend package staging evidence define target paths and compatibility shims.

when_done_rules.round: Round 5 - Backend Package Staging
when_done_rules.item: At least one supported backend path imports from `app/backend`.
when_done_rules.evidence: Backend package staging evidence verifies app/backend server/runtime paths and compatibility import shims.

when_done_rules.round: Round 5 - Backend Package Staging
when_done_rules.item: Existing callers continue through shims during the transition.
when_done_rules.evidence: Backend package staging evidence verifies core runtime compatibility import paths.

when_done_rules.round: Round 5 - Backend Package Staging
when_done_rules.item: Legacy desktop and headless runtime do not gain new cross-imports.
when_done_rules.evidence: Supported import-boundary and legacy boundary scans reject new unsupported cross-imports.

when_done_rules.round: Round 5 - Backend Package Staging
when_done_rules.item: Headless import-block tests remain the primary gate.
when_done_rules.evidence: Supported import-boundary scan is embedded in the final goal audit as a release gate.

when_done_rules.round: Round 6 - Remote Web and Electron Source Separation
when_done_rules.item: Supported web source and user-downloaded UI assets have separate ownership.
when_done_rules.evidence: Source layout contract and runtime asset classification separate app/web source from runtime UI assets.

when_done_rules.round: Round 6 - Remote Web and Electron Source Separation
when_done_rules.item: PyQt tab/UI leftovers are not confused with web UI.
when_done_rules.evidence: Legacy PyQt surface classification and Remote Web feature contract keep desktop UI and web UI ownership separate.

when_done_rules.round: Round 6 - Remote Web and Electron Source Separation
when_done_rules.item: Electron shell can be developed without moving backend services.
when_done_rules.evidence: Electron shell contract and backend package staging evidence keep shell ownership separate from backend services.

when_done_rules.round: Round 7 - Electron Shell Prototype
when_done_rules.item: Electron shell can host the existing Remote Web UI without using a normal browser tab.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke reaches the Remote Web entry URL in the owned shell and observes a ready backend state.

when_done_rules.round: Round 7 - Electron Shell Prototype
when_done_rules.item: Electron owns backend lifecycle and app window lifecycle.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke proves shell-owned runtime state and backend restart recovery.

when_done_rules.round: Round 7 - Electron Shell Prototype
when_done_rules.item: Startup failure produces a visible maintenance/error view with logs.
when_done_rules.evidence: Electron shell contract verifies backend logs are captured, exposed through shell state, rendered in the maintenance view, and accessible through the Open logs shell control.

when_done_rules.round: Round 7 - Electron Shell Prototype
when_done_rules.item: Browser launch remains a fallback, not the primary UX.
when_done_rules.evidence: Electron shell contract verifies the primary Remote Web entry stays in the owned shell while the browser fallback is an explicit filtered shell action.

when_done_rules.item: Backend binary/runtime strategy is chosen with evidence.

when_done_rules.round: Round 8 - Backend Packaging and Antivirus Risk Gate
when_done_rules.item: PyInstaller is accepted only if false-positive handling is practical.

when_done_rules.round: Round 8 - Backend Packaging and Antivirus Risk Gate
when_done_rules.item: A non-PyInstaller backend runtime path remains available if PyInstaller risk is unacceptable.
when_done_rules.evidence: Backend runtime strategy selects a Python runtime folder path as the first milestone.

when_done_rules.round: Round 8 - Backend Packaging and Antivirus Risk Gate
when_done_rules.item: Electron can start and stop the chosen backend runtime.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke proves the packaged backend reaches ready state and recovers after shell-driven restart.

when_done_rules.item: Packaged app starts the headless server and hosts the UI in an owned desktop window.
when_done_rules.evidence: Real portable Electron build and packaged CDP smoke prove a ready backend and hosted UI from the packaged app.

when_done_rules.round: Round 9 - Packaged App Integration
when_done_rules.item: Build output contains no PyQt6 or legacy desktop payload.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged clean-machine and feature-smoke gates pass against the generated win-unpacked artifact.

when_done_rules.round: Round 9 - Packaged App Integration
when_done_rules.item: Logs are accessible from the Electron shell.
when_done_rules.evidence: Electron shell contract verifies log capture, shell-state exposure, maintenance-view rendering, and runtime logs folder access.

when_done_rules.round: Round 9 - Packaged App Integration
when_done_rules.item: Core Remote Web workflows pass from the packaged app, not just from the source checkout.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP feature smoke observes all required Remote Web feature surfaces.

when_done_rules.item: A clean Windows machine can run the packaged app.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged clean-machine gate and Electron CDP smoke pass against a real non-dry-run build.

when_done_rules.item: Startup and supported Remote Web workflows are validated from the release artifact.
when_done_rules.evidence: Packaged Electron CDP smoke records startup timing and observes all required Remote Web feature surfaces.

when_done_rules.item: Release notes list external dependencies such as NovelAI, WebUI, ComfyUI endpoints, and optional downloadable data.
